note: One primitive camping spot beside the small gravel lot at the south end of this Missouri River bottomland area; no pads, tables or toilet, and open fires are not allowed. The entry road off Highway 159 passes under a railroad bridge whose clearance is not posted anywhere online - check it before driving a tall rig in. The bottom floods, and the levee district closes the north access when the river is near flood stage. --Claude
summary: Stays under the lot rule (map symbol + GIS camping point beside the south lot), with a stated caveat: the railroad underpass on the entry road has NO published clearance - could not be confirmed against 10 ft 6 in. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; phone matches. Pin sits in a field edge 55 m from the lot.
flags: RAILROAD BRIDGE CLEARANCE - UNKNOWN (drop if under 10 ft 6 in): the page directions say the entry road 'goes beneath RR bridge to parking lot'. Neither the area page, the brochure (11/2025) nor the map gives a clearance, and a web search found no figure (one third-party listing only says the poster was 'not sure on the clearance of this bridge'). On the 380 m frame the road passes under a railroad trestle and then curves to the lot; height cannot be measured from above. An OpenStreetMap query for a maxheight tag timed out - unread. A question for MDC (816-271-3100 or Nodaway Valley CA 660-446-3371) or a look on the ground; the caveat is in the note.

INCLUSION (lot rule - stays): page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map' and 'No open fires'. The map draws one Primitive Camping Area symbol just west of the south parking lot. GIS layer 27: one point at 40.05619,-95.41709 = the stored pin; the lot (OBJECTID 3206) is at 40.05585,-95.41662, 55 m south-east. On imagery the lot is a small gravel pull-off; the camping point plots in the edge of a crop field north-west of it, with no pad, loop or table visible. So it is camping beside a small lot, at a point MDC designates. The area was bought by the Corps of Engineers (Missouri River mitigation) and is managed with MDC; ownership 'state' kept since MDC runs it - say if this should change.
PIN: stored 40.05619,-95.41709 (GIS point) falls in a field edge. The drivable spot is the lot at 40.05585,-95.41662 (55 m). Small optional move.

ACCESS: brochure: 'Vehicle access from the north gate to the blue hole parking lot will be closed by the Levee District when the Missouri River is at or near flood stage.' The whole area is river bottom. Map acreage 1,217; page says 811.2.
PHONE: stored 816-271-3100 matches the page; the brochure also gives Nodaway Valley CA 660-446-3371.
